audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-3 are stored as Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir, Skill while the early paragraph states 'Teemo wins levels 1-4' and whys[0] through whys[3] each end with 'favouring him' / 'keep you off the wave' / 'staying ahead'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir) matches all seven whys[] lines and the early paragraph. The page currently prints Vladimir's name on levels 2 and 3 over text explaining why he loses them.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 all become Teemo. Rows 4, 5 and 6 are already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on 'engage only on Blinding Dart's cooldown' without ever giving the number, and Noxious Trap is treated as an ability with a normal cast rhythm.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — it does not shorten as he levels, which is unusual and worth stating. Noxious Trap has a 0.25s cooldown and is charge-based, so waiting for it to be 'down' is not a plan; its range grows 600/750/900 and a mushroom thrown onto another mushroom bounces further.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart: flat 7s, 680 range. Noxious Trap: charge-based, effectively always available. Hemoplague reaches 625 against his 680 auto range, so he chooses the distance.

audit.whatIsWrong: Guerrilla Warfare is not mentioned in a single field. Toxic Shot's on-hit nature is described only as 'poison' with no note that it scales with attack speed. And nothing states the range relationship that decides who initiates.
audit.why: Teemo can hold invisibility while MOVING inside brush, so every bush on the lane is a fog check against a champion with no dash and no reveal. Toxic Shot applying on-hit means his damage grows with attack-speed items, so reading the trade off his AP is wrong.
audit.corrected: Guerrilla Warfare lets him move invisibly through brush — treat every bush as occupied, since you have no dash out. Toxic Shot is on-hit and scales with attack speed. Blinding Dart blocks basic attacks only: Transfusion, Tides of Blood and Hemoplague all land through a blind. Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so charge it inside your own wave.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds autos — NOT your Q. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Blinding Dart: a flat 7s at every rank, 680 range, and it blinds AUTOS only — Transfusion and Tides of Blood land regardless. - Noxious Trap: charge-based, so he always has one. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.before: That is Teemo's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Toxic Shot is on-hit, so his damage scales with attack speed, not just AP.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Shrooms bounce off each other for extra range — check the brush.

edits.before: Roughly even at 6 — Hemoplague (R) lets you burst him if you get on top, but his ultimate (Noxious Trap) shrooms wall off your approaches and blind still cancels your AA windows, so you can't reliably all-in yet.
edits.after: Roughly even at 6 — Hemoplague (R) reaches 625 while he autos at 680, and Noxious Trap (R) is charge-based at 600 range, so shrooms wall your approach and you cannot reliably all-in him yet without a jungler.

notes: UNVERIFIED AND LOAD-BEARING: three fields tell the player Sanguine Pool 'cleanses' Noxious Trap slows — spikes[2].text ('Sanguine Pool cleanses the Noxious Trap slow so shrooms stop zoning you'), the late paragraph, and wants.you[2]. Riot's text gives the pool 2 seconds of untargetability and nothing about removing an applied slow. spikes[3] goes further and tells the player to 'dive him through a shroom with Sanguine Pool active'. If the cleanse is not real, that line walks a paying user into a shroom on purpose. I left all three alone rather than guess in either direction — this needs a ruling before the next pass.
